```
['simplify a Natural Questions example by converting HTML tokens to plain text and removing byte offsets', 'get blank-separated tokens from a simplified Natural Questions example document text', 'clean a token by replacing blanks with underscores for HTML table cell tokens', 'remove start_byte and end_byte fields from an NQ annotation span dictionary', 'clean an NQ annotation by removing HTML byte offsets from long and short answers']

```
